messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: hosted-api queue depth (us-east-1) exceeded 95th percentile threshold for 3m. p95 latency 4.8s -> 12.1s, p99 9s -> 28s. Error spike: 504s/timeouts. Automatically opened thread.

sam: paging @oncall, I'm awake. seeing huge backlog on the request queue for 'text.generate' route in us-east.

elaine: confirming. dashboards show continuous queue growth since 03:12 UTC, sustained QPS spike ~3x baseline and GPU pool allocation stuck at max for that tier.

matt: autoscaler logs show repeated create attempts hitting cloud quota for GPUs. Provisioner errors: `RateLimitExceeded` then `ExceededMaxRegions` — looks like we can't add more infra.

ryan: customer reports incoming: CS reported 3 customers seeing streaming hangs (no tokens) + lots of client-side 504s. jill-cs, can you confirm severity?

jill-cs: confirmed with 2 enterprise customers. visible as intermittent 504 + retries. Customer impact: degraded UX, some requests failing ~20% p99. They flagged priority.

sam: current mitigation plan: 1) throttle/ shed low-priority routes 2) enable fallback to smaller quantized model variant 3) prune long-running KV-cache sessions 4) attempt manual scale with emergency quota request.

kai: I can flip fallback route now. It's a config toggle: `routing.fallback_model=redwood-mini-q4_8b` and route-weight 20% then ramp. Any objections?

elaine: do it. also start shedding `batch-async` and `expensive-rerank` routes first. Those are safe to drop for now.

matt: starting quota escalation with cloud support, filed ticket #CLOUD-9941 with high priority and ETA unknown. Meanwhile I'll try to spin up thin GPUs in eu-west as cross-region fallback.

sam: executing emergency measures now:
```
# block low-priority routes
redwoodctl routes set-priority --route batch-async --priority low
redwoodctl routes set-throttle --route expensive-rerank --rate 0
# enable fallback
redwoodctl routing set-fallback --route text.generate --model redwood-mini-q4_8b --weight 0.2
```

ryan: note: enabling fallback will reduce quality for some prompts. CS notified? jill-cs?

jill-cs: notified customers on active sessions. gave mitigation summary and ETA unknown for full recovery. they asked for per-request logs; giving them link to streaming logs.

kai: fallback toggled to 20% now. traffic split shows immediate drop in queuing rate by ~18%. p95 trending down to 7.2s.

elaine: good. start killing idle KV caches older than 10m to free memory on workers: `runtime/kv/prune --older-than 600`. Sam can you run?

sam: pruning KV caches now. also increasing `max-inflight-per-worker` temporarily from 16 -> 24 for small models (non-GPU bound) to absorb some short requests.

matt: provisioner attempted cross-region spinup but kept getting quota/soft limit on image creation. I was able to create 2 thin-gpu nodes in eu-west as preemptible; routing added them as hot spares.

ryan: we should also enable circuit-breaker on client-side heavy tenants: set `tenant.ramp_rate=0.5` for top noisy tenants. Any objections?

elaine: do it. low-risk, helps cut burst.

sam: applied tenant ramp rate to the top 5 noisy tenants. Observed queue drain accelerate. p95 down to 5.1s, p99 down to ~11s. Timeouts dropping.

matt: cloud ticket escalated to phone call. they pinged quotas team, asked for temporary uplift for 2h. keeping fingers crossed.

ryan: oncall handover plan: I'll stay until queue < threshold and p99 < 10s for 15m. sam, can you take postmortem? elaine will do routing follow-up and model owners will validate quality regression window.

sam: noted. will collect traces, request-ids, and examples of fallback responses. will start an eval run comparing output quality for a sample prompt set.

jill-cs: customers acknowledged mitigations and will monitor. asked for a summary email and ETA for full resolution.

incident-bot: Incident severity set to Sev2. Pager duty: oncall @ryan assigned. Incident channel created: #inc-6790012345.

ryan: quick note: no code rollback needed. root cause appears to be demand spike + quota exhaustion blocking autoscaler add. Long-term action items: 1) add pre-authorized buffer for emergency GPU quota 2) smarter cross-region warm pools 3) per-tenant circuit breakers + backpressure by default.

sam: collecting logs and will open a postmortem ticket. tagging `eng-runtime`, `eng-infra`, `product`, `cs`. I'll attach timeline and list of mitigations including commands run and the exact timestamps.

elaine: thanks team. I'll keep monitoring. if cloud ups quota we can scale to stable levels; otherwise we'll keep fallback and throttles until peak subsides.
